items.find_spot: Anetaki plot (Bougada Metochi), Neopalatial cult building, Room 1, votive deposit NW corner
items.in_corpus_ra: no (record present but tokens dropped by the la71 parse: transliteratedWords empty)
items.data_note: lineara.xyz Unicode: AB028 AB081 AB040 AB060 AB077 AB051 [break] AB120 AB120 AB122, each as its own word; the editors describe face B as six sign-groups followed by three logograms GRA, FAR(?), OLIV, no numbers; signs KU, WI, RA named. Group boundaries not given, so no sign-group is usable.
items.confidence: medium for the three logograms and their order (two independent sources agree on GRA ... OLIV); low for syllabic identities and grouping

items.id: KN Zg 57 (faces A, C, D, beyond lineara KNZg57a)
items.in_corpus_ra: face A partly (KNZg57a: *401+RU, *652, *653, *401+RU, *418+L2, NI, VAS); faces C and D no
items.data_note: Prose only: face C >= 9 sign-groups + 5 TELA; face D ~9 HIDE; A, KU, DI, KA occur more than once on the ring. About 84 signs preserved + 35 traces. No numerals on the ring.

items.find_spot: same votive deposit as KN Zg 57
items.data_note: Accounting text. alpha: two VAS ligatures, a numeral 10, a probable new sign, then signs *180 and *181 (known from Cretan Hieroglyphic). beta: a 4-sign sequence (first sign doubtful). delta: units followed by SIX DIFFERENT fraction signs in sequence (order not published). 13.2 cm.

items.data_note: Editor prefers AB 39-58 A 301+A 303 (or AB 21f+A 303); Godart: AB 21f 20 (or 30), i.e. a logogram plus a numeral. Readings contested.
